title: My New Home
text:
My family has a new house. It is small, but it is very nice. There is a big table in the kitchen and two soft beds in the bedroom.

My favorite room is the living room. It has a blue sofa and a large window. In the evening, I read a book there with my dog.

questions.text: How many beds are in the bedroom?
What color is the sofa in the living room?
Why does the writer like the living room best?
options: It is the biggest room in the house.
It is a comfortable place to relax.
It is next to the kitchen.

questions.text: What can we guess about the family's house?
options: It is very large and old.
It is not big, but the family is happy with it.
It has no furniture at all.
It is far from the city.

vocabulary.definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
a long, soft seat for several people
an opening in a wall that lets in light and air

paragraph_translations: Minha família tem uma casa nova. Ela é pequena, mas é muito bonita. Há uma mesa grande na cozinha e duas camas macias no quarto.
Meu cômodo favorito é a sala de estar. Ela tem um sofá azul e uma janela grande. À noite, eu leio um livro ali com o meu cachorro.
